claims: The annual ticket lottery for Masters tickets is on Masters.com.
Applications for Masters tickets for the following year usually open in June.

Winners of the Masters ticket lottery are notified in July.
Practice rounds for the Masters are Mon-Wed.
Tournament days for the Masters are Thu-Sun.
Third-party sites like StubHub offer Masters tickets often for $1,200+ per ticket.
Augusta National strictly prohibits resale of Masters tickets.
Masters tickets acquired through secondary markets can be voided.
